user: Hi, I'm a freelance graphic designer and I opted for the 8% income tax rate.
response:
As a freelancer who opted for the 8% income tax rate, your tax will be based on your gross sales or receipts, not on net income. Since you are under the 8% regime, you cannot deduct business expenses from your income. Additionally, if your income comes purely from your freelance work, you would typically be entitled to a reduction of PHP 250,000 from your gross income before applying the 8% tax. However, if you have mixed income sources, this reduction does not apply to your business income [S2, S3]. 

Please verify your specific situation with a CPA or your Revenue District Office (RDO).
